_meta.description: Reaction effect rating logic from ASTM MNL36 Table 4-2.

ratings.label: Negligible
ratings.system_objectives: No unacceptable effect on production, storage, transportation, distribution, or use as applicable
ratings.functional_capability: No unacceptable damage to the system

ratings.label: Marginal
ratings.effect_on_personnel_safety: Personnel-injuring factors can be controlled by automatic devices, warning devices, or special operating procedures
ratings.system_objectives: Production, storage, transportation, distribution, or use as applicable is possible by utilizing available redundant operational options
ratings.functional_capability: No more than one component or subsystem damaged and repairable or replaceable within an acceptable time frame on site

ratings.label: Critical
ratings.effect_on_personnel_safety: Personnel may be injured operating the system, maintaining the system, or by being in the vicinity of the system
ratings.system_objectives: Production, storage, transportation, distribution, or use as applicable impaired seriously
ratings.functional_capability: Two or more major subsystems are damaged and extensive maintenance is required

ratings.label: Catastrophic
ratings.effect_on_personnel_safety: Personnel suffer death or multiple injuries
ratings.system_objectives: Production, storage, transportation, distribution, or use as applicable rendered impossible; major unit is lost
ratings.functional_capability: No portion of system can be salvaged; total loss
